aliases_and_boundary: Empyrean / Empyreans. Use the player conversion of the celestial species. Other celestials keep separate profiles.
Ettin / Ettins. Keep the two heads in one character profile and other giant species separate.
Faerie Dragon / Faerie Dragons. Use the Tiny player profile. The printed player spell list uses the red form. Age colors do not create separate claims.
Flameskull / Flameskulls. Keep the distinct Demilich profile separate.
Flumph / Flumphs. Keep the Small aberration's flight and manipulation rules in its own profile.
Galeb Duhr / Galeb-Duhr. Keep the stone elemental separate from Rockborn and other animated stone folk.
Gargoyle / Gargoyles. Use the elemental player profile and its False Appearance. Keep Helmed Horror and other constructs separate.
Gibbering Mouther / Gibbering Mouthers. Use the aberration's player traits. Keep oozes and other shapeless folk separate.
Grell is the printed name. Use the floating aberration's player rules and anatomy.
Grick / Gricks. Scope the trait block to ordinary Grick. Existing Grick Alpha encounter entries stay separate.
Helmed Horror / Helmed Horrors. Separate player traits from Animated Object and its Animated Armor form.
Hippogriff / Hippogriffs. Use the player creature and keep Griffon, Pegasus, and Pegataur separate.
Homunculus / Homunculi. Use its Small player traits. Keep Homunculus Servant and ordinary companion rules separate.
Hook Horror / Hook Horrors. Apply the printed hook restrictions. Keep closely shaped creatures separate.
Hydra / Hydras. Keep head counts and regrowth under one character profile.
Intellect Devourer / Intellect Devourers. Keep the Tiny player profile separate from mind flayers and other psionic aberrations.
Invisible Stalker / Invisible Stalkers. Keep its player form and invisibility conditions within the same profile.
Jackalwere / Jackalweres. One profile covers the alternate forms. Keep lycanthropy and other jackal folk separate.
Kraken / Krakens. Use the player-sized conversion. Keep campaign and encounter krakens in their original scopes.
Manticore / Manticores. Use the printed player version. Keep Chimera separate.
Nothic / Nothics. Preserve the player trait limits. Other magically transformed creatures are separate.
Otyugh / Otyughs. Use player traits for the refuse-dwelling aberration. Keep encounter variants separate.
Peryton / Perytons. Use the player form, separate from Birdfolk and Hippogriff.
Rust Monster / Rust Monsters. Keep the player rusting rules. Use the encounter entry separately.
Shambling Mound / Shambling Mounds. Keep it separate from Blight, Briarvex, and Wood Woad.
Banderhobb / Banderhobbs. Use the created shadow creature's player traits. The DMs Guild sample also covers this profile.
Bodak / Bodaks. Scope to the undead player profile and keep other undead separate.
Boggle / Boggles. Preserve both types of oil in one profile with the printed portal rules.
Catoblepas is the printed name. Use the player's gaze, stench, and anatomy rules.
Cave Fisher / Cave Fishers. Use the player profile with its filament. Keep other cave predators separate.
Cranium Rat / Cranium Rats. Use one individual Tiny creature. Keep swarm mechanics and Ratling separate.

rule_locator: p. 21, Darkling Traits, and p. 86, Darkling Elder racial feat
aliases_and_boundary: Darkling / Darklings. Record Darkling Elder as a feat of this species, with no second lineage claim.
Devourer / Devourers. This is the fiend in the sequel. Keep the unrelated Intellect Devourer separate.
Draegloth / Draegloths. Use the fiendish player traits. Keep Drow and other demon-derived creatures separate.

Firenewt / Firenewts. Same-name monster stat blocks and Giant Strider remain separate. Keep the printed player traits together. The play advice mentions Imix’s Blessing without supplying a feat block.
Giant Strider / Firenewt Giant Strider, the section title. The mount species has its own player traits separate from Firenewt.
Flail Snail / Flail Snails. Keep this elemental under its own entry.
Froghemoth / Froghemoths. Use the scaled-down player version. Keep other amphibious creatures separate.
Girallon / Girallons. Keep the four-arm rules within one profile. Other ape species remain separate.

rule_locator: pp. 42–43, shared Guard Drake Traits and chromatic variants
aliases_and_boundary: Guard Drake / Guard Drakes. Keep Black, Blue, Green, Red, and White choices together under Guard Drake.
Ki-rin / Kirin. Keep the celestial player option separate from Unicorn and other equine species.
Korred / Korreds. Use this supplement's player profile and keep other fey separate.
Leucrotta / Leucrottas. Use the player conversion and its manipulation limits.
Meenlock / Meenlocks. Use the player version. Keep unrelated fear-themed ancestries separate.

rule_locator: pp. 53–54, Mindwitness Traits, and p. 97, Mindwitness spells
aliases_and_boundary: Mindwitness / Mindwitnesses. It has its own traits in this book. Keep it separate from the prior Beholder profile and its three forms.
Morkoth / Morkoths. Use the player's aquatic and magical traits. Keep similar aberrations separate.

rule_locator: p. 56, Neogi Traits, and p. 88, Neogi Master racial feat
aliases_and_boundary: Neogi is the printed name. Keep its published character options within one profile. Keep Neothelid separate.
Neothelid / Neothelids. Use the player version of the wormlike aberration and keep the mind flayer profiles separate.
Tlincalli / scorpionfolk, a descriptive name. Use the supplement's player form. Keep other arthropod species separate.
Wood Woad / Wood Woads. Use the player form with Tree Stride and keep other plant species separate.
